verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Decagon publishes an llms.txt file at decagon.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The excerpt reads as a marketing-level product summary, and nothing shows deeper agent-oriented technical docs; the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links to substantive technical or API documentation, a machine-readable API spec or llms-full.txt, independent or hands-on corroboration of usefulness to agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
